title: calceolaria mexicana subsp. perijensis
intro: Calceolaria mexicana subsp. perijensis, commonly known as the Mexican pocket flower, is a species of flowering plant in the Calceolaria genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, contributing to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Calceolaria mexicana subsp. perijensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of this plant, and its use should be approached with caution.
